traps.title: UPSC Common Exam Traps
items: Confusing the location of Enlightenment (Bodh Gaya) with the first sermon (Sarnath).
Assuming Buddhism rejected the concept of Karma (it redefined it, didn't reject it).
Believing Buddha claimed to be a God; he identified as a human teacher.

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Geography

  • Birth: Lumbini
  • Enlightenment: Bodh Gaya
  • First Sermon: Sarnath
  • Death: Kushinagar

Personalities

  • Father: Suddhodana (Shakya)
  • Mother: Mahamaya
  • Charioteer: Channa
  • Horse: Kanthaka
  • Core Philosophy
    • Four Noble Truths (Aryasatyas)
    • Eightfold Path (Ashtangika Marga)
    • Dependent Origination (Pratityasamutpada)
